digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions bridge workflows and core push infrastructure
propositions: Both reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows must delegate to single core push entrypoints and remove inline CAS/fetch/merge/retry loops
Strict workflow delivery remains synchronous and red on exhausted failure while core owns retry and CAS recovery
Reconciler bot identity, commit subject, and author metadata must be preserved across the migration
Raw-git exemption and stale synthetic test rationale must be removed from workflow configurations and test files
Python library and MCP push defaults remain best-effort; only strict CLI workflow adapters change to use core push contracts
Real-git workflow smoke tests must validate successful delivery with correct authorship and red disposition on rejected pushes
